2. Atualizar as skills c2f-architect-master, sdd-memory-gardening e sdd-workflow em todos os toolkits (.claude, .codex, .gemini, .github, .cursor) com a Regra dos 10 Ativos na Raiz SDD.
3. Executar ./c2f ai:archive-sdd em todos os repositórios (conn2flow, conn2flow-ai-workspace, conn2flow-site, lumix, transformamp).
4. Validar php cli/c2f.php ai:sync (36/36 skills verdes).
5. Emitir completions/BATCH-050-executor-receipt.json.
